description: THE ENTER-WITH-PRESELECTION HANDOFF - the only path in this program where a FIRST entry performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. Derived from app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:99-149 and specifically :112-122, with :154-244 and :319-338 reached from it. Every other case in this directory that reaches PROCESS-ENTER-KEY arrives on the re-entry arm, through the DFHENTER WHEN of the EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-127; this one arrives at :120, with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT still 0, because a transaction was carried in. Modelled as a re-entry it would be a different branch of the source. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 set ERR-FLG-OFF and USR-MODIFIED-NO, :104-105 move SPACES to WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO, :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero so the cold-start arm at :108-109 is not taken, :111 copies the travelled area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, :112 finds NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER true because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 0, :113 SETs CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE so the context leaves as 1 and the next keystroke takes the other arm - and note it is advanced BEFORE :120, so the area PROCESS-ENTER-KEY carries is already at re-enter, :114 clears all 294 bytes of the map with MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COBIL0AO, :115 moves -1 into ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI, :116-117 test CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED against SPACES AND LOW-VALUES - an abbreviated combined relation meaning equal to neither - and this time a value IS carried, so :118-119 move it into ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI and :120 performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, and then :122 performs SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN unconditionally. THE WIDTH MISMATCH, WHICH IS THIS CASE'S HEADLINE. CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED is PIC X(16) at :72; ACTIDINI is PIC X(11) in app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY. The move at :118-119 is therefore a cross-width ALPHANUMERIC move, and a PIC X receiver is filled from the left and discards the overflow on the RIGHT: '0000000000199999' becomes '00000000001' and the five low-order characters '99999' are gone. That is the opposite end from the numeric rule - a PIC 9 receiver is aligned on its implied decimal point and discards on the LEFT - and the value is chosen so the two cannot be confused. Right truncation yields '00000000001', which acctdata.txt row 0 holds, so READ-ACCTDAT-FILE takes DFHRESP(NORMAL) and the balance is displayed. Left truncation would yield '00000199999', which no row of the fixture holds - the fifty accounts are 00000000001 through 00000000050 - so it would take the DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm at :359-364 and paint 'Account ID NOT found...' with the cursor at ACTIDINL instead. The assertion therefore cannot pass by accident in either direction. THE SECOND CONVERSION, AND THE VALIDATION THAT IS ABSENT. :170-171 are one MOVE with two receivers, ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID, both PIC 9(11), from a PIC X(11) sender: an equal-width alphanumeric-to-numeric move. There is NO numeric edit, no NUMVAL, no IS NUMERIC test and no rejection of a non-numeric identifier anywhere in this program's 572 lines - CORPT00C and COTRN02C are the two programs that call CSUTLDTC and use FUNCTION NUMVAL-C, and COBIL00C is neither. That absence is inherited behaviour and is preserved rather than repaired, so no validation expectation is stated here. WHICH ARM OF EVALUATE CONFIRMI, AND WHY IT IS NOT THE ONE IT LOOKS LIKE. :114 cleared the whole overlay - 01 COBIL0AO REDEFINES COBIL0AI, so one MOVE reaches both views - and :118-119 wrote only ACTIDINI, so CONFIRMI is still LOW-VALUES when :173 evaluates it. The switch has five arms in this order: WHEN 'Y' :174, WHEN 'y' :175, WHEN 'N' :178, WHEN 'n' :179, WHEN SPACES :182, WHEN LOW-VALUES :183, WHEN OTHER :185. EVALUATE is ordered and the first match wins, so the arm taken is WHEN LOW-VALUES at :183 - X'00' is not X'20' and a map cleared to low-values does not equal one cleared to spaces - which falls into the same PERFORM READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :184 as the WHEN SPACES arm above it. WHEN OTHER stays last, unreached (gate G30). CONF-PAY-NO therefore survives from :156, and nothing is paid. THE REST OF THE PARAGRAPH, STAGE BY STAGE. Stage 1, the EVALUATE TRUE at :158-167: ACTIDINI is '00000000001', which is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES, so the reject at :159-164 is skipped and the WHEN OTHER / CONTINUE at :165-166 is taken - the no-op arm of an ordered EVALUATE, taken deliberately. Stage 2 is the confirmation switch above, reaching READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :343-354, whose EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :356 takes DFHRESP(NORMAL) / CONTINUE - the arm gate G47 asks for - and whose READ carries the UPDATE option at :351, so the record is read under a lock inside the task's unit of work even though this arm never rewrites it. Then :193-194, unconditional within the :169 guard, edit the balance onto the screen. Stage 3, the compound guard at :197-199: ACCT-CURR-BAL is +194.00, which is above zero, so 'You have nothing to pay...' is not raised. Stage 4, the IF CONF-PAY-YES at :210: false, so the ELSE at :236-240 moves 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' to WS-MESSAGE at :237-238 and -1 to CONFIRML at :239 - and note what this arm does NOT do: it sets no error flag, because it is a prompt and not a rejection. :242 then sends. TWO SENDS ARE ISSUED, ONE IMAGE IS OBSERVABLE. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN runs twice on this arm: once at :242 inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY and once at :122 in MAIN-PARA, which is unconditional and therefore additional. Neither is collapsed into the other. Both transmit BYTE-IDENTICAL payloads, because nothing between them changes any of the ten items: :291 re-runs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO against the same pinned instant and :293 moves the same WS-MESSAGE over the same ERRMSGO. The traced count is two and it is recorded here as such; the single ScreenSend below is that shared image, which is what the payload seam projects - a stateless screen returns one body, carrying the screen as the last send left it. The send COUNT is asserted at the service seam by the sibling cases that reach :532 and :242 within one PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. THE CURSOR MOVES, AND THAT IS THE OBSERVABLE DIFFERENCE FROM A FIRST ENTRY WITH NOTHING SELECTED. Two MOVE -1 statements run here - ACTIDINL at :115 and CONFIRML at :239 - and the CURSOR option of the SEND at :300 honours the last one to run, so the cursor is at CONFIRM and cursorField is CONFIRML. A first entry that carries nothing never reaches :239 and comes back at ACTIDINL, so this single field distinguishes the two paths. A cursor is an xxxL length item, which is why it is declared as cursorField rather than as a payload member. THE 58-BYTE EXTENSION. CDEMO-CB00-INFO at :64-72 is CDEMO-CB00-TRNID-FIRST PIC X(16) + CDEMO-CB00-TRNID-LAST PIC X(16) + CDEMO-CB00-PAGE-NUM PIC 9(08) + CDEMO-CB00-NEXT-PAGE-FLG PIC X(01) VALUE 'N', carrying 88 NEXT-PAGE-YES 'Y' and 88 NEXT-PAGE-NO 'N' + CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SEL-FLG PIC X(01) + CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED PIC X(16), which is 16+16+8+1+1+16 = 58. It is declared inside the same 01 group as COPY COCOM01Y and so travels in the same DFHCOMMAREA, but it is NOT part of the shared 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (4+8+4+8+8+1+1 = 34, plus 9+25+25+25 = 84, plus 11+1 = 12, plus 16, plus 7+7 = 14) and is not folded into it here: all six are declared as their own named request members, at their own widths, and none of them appears among the sixteen navigation carriers of the response. All six are populated explicitly rather than five of them left implied, because a fixed-width COBOL item is never absent. FIVE OF THE SIX ARE NEVER READ BY THIS PROGRAM - verified by exhaustive search of app/cbl and app/cpy, where CDEMO-CB00 appears only at COBIL00C.cbl:64-72, :116 and :118 - and no other program writes any of them, COBIL00C being reached by no XCTL anywhere. TRN-SEL-FLG is given 'S' after the one structural analogue the codebase has, COTRN00C.cbl:185-187, whose CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG selects on 'S' and 's'; it is stated as an input and asserted only in that it is echoed unchanged, since COBIL00C never looks at it. THE TWO BALANCE WIDTHS ARE DIFFERENT THINGS. ACCT-CURR-BAL is PIC S9(10)V99 in app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy: twelve bytes of zoned DISPLAY with the sign OVERPUNCHED into the trailing byte, which in acctdata.txt row 0 is 00000001940{ - the '{' encoding a positive low-order digit zero, so ten integer digits 0000000194 and two fraction digits 00. CURBALI is the EDITED rendering WS-CURR-BAL PIC +9999999999.99 at :56, which is fourteen bytes: a sign position, ten integer digits, a literal '.' and two fraction digits, produced by :193 and moved to the screen at :194 as +0000000194.00. Twelve is the record field and fourteen is the screen field, and neither is the other. The value is a scale-2 BigDecimal throughout, and the store obeys the truncating rule this whole migration is built on: ROUNDED appears zero times in all 28 programs, so RoundingMode.DOWN is the only faithful mode, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN, and no value derived from a PIC 9...V... span is ever a double or a float. This is stated even though NO ARITHMETIC RUNS HERE: this program's single COMPUTE at :234 is inside the CONF-PAY-YES arm, which this path does not enter, so the scale and the mode govern only the edit and the decode. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN, STATED RATHER THAN LEFT SILENT. No WRITE and no REWRITE: :211-235 are inside IF CONF-PAY-YES, so READ-CXACAIX-FILE at :408, the STARTBR / READPREV / ENDBR of the TRANSACT browse, WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE at :377-385 are all unreached, which is why expectedWrites is empty by derivation. CCXREF and TRANSACT are not seeded at all, because seeding them would assert a read this arm does not make; ACCTDAT is seeded because :345-354 genuinely reads it. Nothing is emitted on a message channel: this program's only DISPLAY statements are on the WHEN OTHER arms of the four RESP switches, at :366, :397 and their siblings, and none is reached, so expectedMessages is empty - the screen line is carried by the send that produced it and is not repeated on a second channel, which would double-count one 78-byte field as two expectations. No XCTL: the two transfers at :281-284 are performed only from RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, reached from :109 and from the DFHPF3 arm at :135, so nextProgram is absent and control falls to EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :146-149 - the termination is RETURN_TRANSID and the mapset and map of the SEND at :296-297 are named instead. No attribute is written: COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - DFHRED appears nowhere in the program, and there is therefore no red-plus-asterisk highlight to expect on any path, let alone this one. The only DFHBMSCA constant the program uses is the DFHGREEN of :526, on the transaction-WRITE success arm, which this path never reaches, so the attribute map is empty and must stay empty. No pagination: this screen has no page controls and no OCCURS table, so the page sizes of 7 and 10 that govern the card, transaction and user lists have nothing to do with it. No GO TO anywhere in the program, and no CALL 'CEE3ABD' - it is an online program, so the abend and return-code gates belong to the eleven non-CICS programs. THE SCREEN, FIELD BY FIELD. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN at :289-301 performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :291 first, so the header six come from :319-338: TITLE01O and TITLE02O are CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 at their full PIC X(40) width from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-22, untrimmed, six leading and seven trailing blanks on the first and fourteen leading and eighteen trailing on the second - and the second has a commented-out alternative directly above it in the copybook, which is not the live literal; TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CB00' at :38 and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COBIL00C' at :37, the pair app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:337-338 binds together; CURDATEO is WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY and CURTIMEO is WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS groups app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy assembles, whose '/' and ':' separators are that copybook's FILLER items. ACTIDINO is the truncated identifier and CURBALO the edited balance, both read out of the one buffer the two views share. CONFIRMO is a single X'00': :239 wrote CONFIRML, the length item that positions the cursor, and never CONFIRMI, so the byte :114 cleared is still there - X'00' and not X'20', because BMS does not transmit a null field and the difference is visible at the terminal. ERRMSGO is 'Confirm to make a bill payment...' - thirty-three characters - space-padded to seventy-eight, because :293 moves the eighty-byte WS-MESSAGE over a PIC X(78) receiver and loses the last two bytes; that two-byte difference is the picture difference and not a rounding of the expectation. Only the ten xxxI/xxxO items of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY are payload, at the widths their PICTURE clauses declare - TRNNAME 4, TITLE01 40, CURDATE 8, PGMNAME 8, TITLE02 40, CURTIME 8, ACTIDIN 11, CURBAL 14, CONFIRM 1, ERRMSG 78 - while the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items on the input side and the xxxC, xxxP, xxxH and xxxV items on the output side are length, flag, attribute and highlight metadata and never appear as fields. STATELESSNESS. EIBCALEN is 218 - the 160 bytes of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 58 of the extension. Every scrap of conversation state travels in the request and the response: the context digit :112 tests and :113 flips, the six extension members, and the screen's own values. Nothing is held server-side and nothing is implied to be (gate G37, AAP rule R6). The response pins all sixteen shared carriers, and their only change is the context digit moving from 0 to 1 - which is a real assertion, not a formality, because it says the four RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN stamps at :278-280 did not run on this path. No AID is declared, because EIBAID is not read here: the EVALUATE at :125-142 belongs to the re-entry arm, and naming a key would suggest one mattered. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the same instant every case in this directory pins, and the date the CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 version footer carries - so CURDATEO is 07/19/22 and CURTIMEO is 23:12:32, read once from an injected Clock through common.DateHeader and never from a captured now; a two-digit month, day and hour well clear of midnight, with no daylight-saving edge, so neither rendering is ambiguous. Reading the clock once rather than twice matters: the date and the time are two separate eight-character renderings and two reads could straddle a second boundary. US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default, which across a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND. The paragraph under test is MAIN-PARA's first-entry arm, and the migration puts :112-122 in BillPaymentController.payBill - the context flip, the LOW-VALUES clear of the overlay, the -1 into ACTIDINL, the PIC X(16) into PIC X(11) move, the second SEND at :122, the header six of POPULATE-HEADER-INFO obtained through DateHeader.from(codec, clock), and the echo of the six extension members are all its statements, and BillPaymentService exposes no entry point for any of them. The decision logic this arm reaches at :120 is BillPaymentService.processEnterKey, the real @Service, called by the controller as a plain object with the truncated identifier and the LOW-VALUES confirmation. CONTROLLER_POJO is therefore the kind, and it is also the kind ParityCase requires a screenRequest and an expectedResponse for, which is what this case is made of and the only way the commarea flip, the cursor and the screen can be stated at all. It means the handler constructed through its own constructor and its method called directly: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no WebTestClient, no servlet container, no application context and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path, which is exactly what gate G51 asks for. The arithmetic cases that drive the service directly own the truncating COMPUTE at :234 and the high-order MOVE at :224. PROVENANCE. Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against four authorities: the xxxI and xxxO PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COBIL00.bms for the screen widths, the 300-byte layout of app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy for the account record and its zoned overpunch, the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy and the 58-byte extension at COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 for the communication area, and row 0 of the real app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt for the input data (gate G16) - and it was NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it, because such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. AAP 0.7.6 documents eight verified blockers and 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed; what changes is the provenance of the expected values and nothing else. GATES. G15 as one of the twenty, G16 seeded from the shipped acctdata.txt, G18 diff count zero, G23 scale 2 on every monetary value, G30 the EVALUATE arms in source order with WHEN OTHER last, G37 no server-side state, G38 the ENTER side of the ENTER/REENTER pair with PROCESS-ENTER-KEY reached, G47 the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm of READ-ACCTDAT-FILE, and G51 the unit reached with nothing in between.

fields.ERRMSGO: Confirm to make a bill payment...
